analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: US and JP Equity L/S Still “On”; EU Equity L/S Pauses; US Quant “On”
key_insights: UBS's Deleveraging Indicator for US Equity L/S remains "on" for the fifth consecutive session. Gross outflows have moderated in the US and Europe, but performance remains tough.
October was the worst performance month YTD for Equity L/S in both the US and Europe.
European Equity L/S paused the indicator after two consecutive "on" sessions, as gross reductions stabilised.
Japan Equity L/S reduced gross exposure by -1std after Tuesday's close, so the indicator is active for a second consecutive session.
US Quant strategies are "on" for the third consecutive session, with muted gross outflows yesterday and a difficult start to the month on performance.
EU Quant strategies reduced exposure by -0.7std but the indicator is "off". Japan Quant is "off" but close to triggering.
risk_factors: Continued poor performance in Equity L/S and Quant strategies could trigger further gross exposure reductions.
Japan Quant is close to triggering the deleveraging indicator.
vol_and_positioning: US Equity L/S deleveraging indicator: "on" for the fifth consecutive session. Gross outflows have moderated but performance is weak.
Europe Equity L/S: indicator paused after two consecutive "on" sessions.
Japan Equity L/S: gross exposure cut by -1std after Tuesday's close, indicator "on" for the second consecutive session.
US Quant: indicator "on" for the third consecutive session, gross outflows muted yesterday.
EU Quant: exposure reduced by -0.7std, indicator "off". Japan Quant: "off" but close to triggering.
